suggestion.title: You usually open {{channel}} fastest
suggestion.body_one: Of your last {{total}} urgent alerts, you opened {{count}} first on {{channel}}, usually within {{minutes}} minutes.
suggestion.body_other: Of your last {{total}} urgent alerts, you opened {{count}} first on {{channel}}, usually within {{minutes}} minutes.
suggestion.help: Using {{channel}} first would get urgent alerts to you sooner. You can change this at any time.
suggestion.accepted: Done. Urgent alerts now go to {{channel}} first.
suggestion.declined: OK. We will keep using {{channel}} first.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose how and when KaziForce contacts you outside the app. Everything also appears in the app.
notifications.loadError: We could not load your notification settings.

order.title: Where urgent alerts go first
order.help: We send urgent alerts to your first choice. If you do not open one within 10 minutes, we try the next.
order.needsPhone: Needs a verified phone number. Add one in Your profile.
order.switchedOff: Switched off under Customise, so we skip it.
order.stopped: You replied STOP, so we skip it. Switch it on under Customise to start again.

whatsapp.label: I use WhatsApp
whatsapp.help: Switch this on only if you use WhatsApp on your phone number.

both.label: Send urgent alerts on both
both.help: Your first and second choice get urgent alerts at the same time. SMS may cost more.

presets.title: How much should we tell you?
presets.help: Pick one. You can change the details under Customise.
presets.custom: You changed some settings under Customise, so none of these is picked.

customise.help: Set each channel, quiet hours and the daily email yourself.

channel.label: {{channel}} messages
channel.help: Switch off to never get messages by {{channel}}.
channel.whatHelp: Urgent alerts are jobs and news that cannot wait.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.help: During these hours only urgent alerts reach you. Other messages wait until they end.

summary.label: Summary email
summary.help: The less important things, together in one email. No news, no email.
summary.frequencyHelp: At 8:00 in the morning, with everything since the last summary.

types.title: Types of alerts
types.help: Switch off what you do not need, or choose how each type reaches you outside the app.

names.new_applicant: People who apply for your jobs

helps.new_job: Jobs that match your place or skills.
helps.application_update: When an employer reviews, accepts or turns down your application.
helps.new_applicant: When a worker applies for a job you posted.

types.channelsHelp: You always see them in the app. Untick everything to keep them in the app only.
types.offNote: Off: no pop-ups, no SMS or email. You can still find them in your alerts list.
types.mandatory: Always on. KaziForce sends these to everyone, because they matter for your account or safety.

popups.label: Pop-ups on this phone or computer
popups.help: Alerts pop up even when KaziForce is closed. They show a short line only, never names or details. At night (your quiet hours) they arrive without sound.
popups.unsupported: This browser cannot show pop-ups. On an iPhone, first add KaziForce to your Home Screen (Share, then “Add to Home Screen”), then open it from there.
popups.blocked: Pop-ups are blocked for KaziForce in this browser. To allow them, tap the lock or the “i” next to the web address, then allow Notifications.
popups.error: That did not work. Please try again.

done.on: Pop-ups are on for this device.
done.off: Pop-ups are off for this device.
done.blocked: Pop-ups were blocked. You can allow them in the browser’s settings.

delete.help: We delete your account and everything in it after 14 days. You can change your mind until then.
delete.dialogBody: Your profile, alerts, applications and messages will be deleted after 14 days. Until then you can log in and keep your account.
delete.passwordHelp: To make sure it is really you.
delete.requested: We will delete your account on {{date}}.
delete.pending: Your account will be deleted on {{date}}.
delete.pendingHelp: Changed your mind? Keep your account and everything stays as it is.
delete.kept: Your account is safe. We will not delete it.

font.label: Letter style
font.help: Choose the letters that are easiest for you to read. This phone or computer remembers it.

figtree.name: Figtree
figtree.help: Friendly, clear letters. The usual style.

atkinson.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible
atkinson.help: Extra-clear letters that are hard to mix up, such as I, l and 1.

lexend.name: Lexend
lexend.help: Wide, simple letters made for easy reading.

andika.name: Andika
andika.help: Letters made for new readers, like in school books.

opendyslexic.name: OpenDyslexic
opendyslexic.help: Heavy letters that help some people with dyslexia. A bigger download.

system.name: Your phone's own letters
system.help: The letters your phone or computer already uses. Nothing to download.

settings.title: Settings

language.label: Language
language.help: The language used in the app and in your messages.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.help: Large makes all text and buttons bigger.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.help: Turns off movement and animation on the screen.

settings.profileLinkHelp: Name, place, skills and phone number.
settings.companyLinkHelp: Company name, place and phone number.
settings.logoutAllHelp: Use this if you lost a phone or logged in on someone else's device.
settings.logoutAllBody: You will need to log in again on every phone and computer, including this one.

theme.label: Screen colours
theme.settingsHelp: Light colours, dark colours, or the same as your phone or computer.
